# textkit

Small text helpers.

- `textkit.wordfreq` prints the five most common words in a text file:
  `python3 -m textkit.wordfreq notes.txt`
- `textkit.slugify.slugify(text)` turns a title into a URL slug.
- `textkit.titlecase.titlecase(text)` capitalizes every word.

Run the tests with:

    python3 -m unittest
